verdicts.reason: A breaks the product graphic apart: the sage circle is stranded half off the canvas at the far left while the can floats on the right with empty space around it. Its text is crammed into the centre with SOLSTICE below the headline, which reverses the reading order, and the body copy is too small to read. The CTA is shrunk to badge size and lined up with the badges, so it no longer stands out. B reads left to right as a banner should: the can sits in its circle, then brand and headline, then copy with badges, then a prominent dark CTA at the right. Its only flaws are the very small can, the small body copy and the uneven gaps between columns.
